title: Forge
hint: Merge two copies with the same rarity and upgrade level. Upgrades are guaranteed through +{{level}}. Pets cannot be upgraded.
pairHint: A second copy is chosen automatically: the same item, rarity and upgrade level. A matching equipped copy is always the base and stays equipped; the inventory copy is consumed. If you select equipped gear, that copy is the base. A failed merge consumes gold and the sacrificed copy; the base keeps its level.
failure: Merge failed: {{item}} kept its level. Gold and the sacrificed copy were consumed.
chooseHint: Drag gear onto the Forge input, or click a Gear or equipment slot. Enter or Space also selects an item.
tabsLocked: Only Gear is available while the Forge is open. Close the Forge to use other tabs.
